text:
Priya (PM): quick sync - several customers requested aurora-7. Proposal: mark as EXPERIMENTAL, run a 4% canary for 72h then step to 20% if stable. Need guardrails for pin requests.
Ben (Eng): perf note - we only have fp16 for now. Quantization (4-bit) might land in ~6w but not guaranteed.
Maria (SRE): perf numbers from our staging run: batched p95 ~210ms for 512 tokens at batch=3; cold single-request p95 ~325ms. Suggest GA gate: single p95 <= 290ms.
Tom (ProdOps): rollout suggestion: 4% (72h) -> 20% (48h) -> 100% (monitor 7d). Rollback if error rate >0.4% sustained 1h or p95 degrades >25% vs baseline.
Sasha (SE): enterprise asks: One customer wants a 6-month pin. We should avoid hard pins on experimental models. Thoughts on a middle-ground?
Izzy (Sales): customer (FinSys) is willing to pay a premium. They need stable latency and predictable cost. 3 months + SLA credits might be acceptable.
Ben (Eng): middle-ground: "pinned-routing" that prefers aurora-7 but includes an automated fallback to aurora-7-lite if SLOs hit. Implementable as routing policy with tenant preference + fallback.
Priya (PM): I like that. Proposed bench gates: single_p95_ms <= 290, eval_pass_rate >= 0.94, cost_per_1k_tokens <= $0.13. Also require a quant roadmap (milestones) within 6 weeks to qualify for a GA promo.
Maria (SRE): ops requirement: keep model-variant in cache keys to prevent cross-variant KV collisions when fallback swaps. Also we need per-tenant telemetry: p95, error_rate, cost delta.
Tom (ProdOps): add cost protection: automatic throttle if observed cost_per_1k > $0.15 for >30m or if estimated bill outpaces baseline by >40% in 24h.
Ben (Eng): will add runtime cost-throttle policy. Also will prepare canary automation to step traffic and trigger rollbacks.
Sasha (SE): legal flag: per-tenant hard-pins require a standard exception form and platform escrow. Tagging @LegalBot.
LegalBot: noted - hard-pin exceptions require signoff from Legal + Security. Draft clause template required; I can start one.
Izzy (Sales): action - I'll probe FinSys for 3mo pin + credits; will push back on any 6mo hard lock.
Priya (PM): decision summary: (1) onboard aurora-7 as experimental, (2) 4% -> 20% -> 100% canary plan, (3) allow "pinned-routing" soft pin with fallback variant, (4) bench gates as above, (5) quant roadmap due in 6w. Approve? react :thumbsup: or :eyes:.
Ben (Eng): :thumbsup: will own quant roadmap + canary infra.
Maria (SRE): :thumbsup: ops will own monitoring alerts and rollback playbook.
Sasha (SE): :eyes: will coordinate legal for pin exceptions.
Izzy (Sales): :thumbsup: will report back on customer negotiation.
deploy-bot: Draft created: model-catalog entry aurora-7 (draft-id=mc-aurora7-2026).
Priya (PM): thanks all. I'll draft the RFC & catalog entry with these fields and target canary next Wed. Closing thread.
